name: Hatsukoi Monogatari
source:
An ordinary Japanese student finds a floppy disk on the street; using his computer to load data from it, he miraculously summons Foltjunia, an intergalactic warrior who fights evil in her robotic armor with three companions. However, Foltjunia has lost her powers and as a result stays with the hero, giving him advice as to how to conquer the love of a schoolmate.

[from [url=http://www.mobygames.com/game/turbografx-cd/hatsukoi-monogatari]MobyGames[/url]]

Your father gets a job transfer and is taking the family with him. You have three months to make your feelings known to your crush.

The initial character creation determines whether this happens in primary, middle, or high school.
translation:
一名普通的日本学生在街上发现一张软盘；他使用计算机加载数据，奇迹般地召唤了星际战士Foltjunia，她穿着机器人装甲与三个同伴一起对抗邪恶。然而，福尔朱尼亚失去了力量，因此留在了英雄身边，为他提供如何赢得同学之爱的建议。

[来自[url=http://www.mobygames.com/game/turbografx-cd/hatsukoi-monogatari]MobyGames[/url]]

你父亲调动工作并带着家人一起去。你有三个月的时间向你喜欢的人表达你的感受。

最初的角色创建决定了这种情况是否发生在小学、初中或高中。
